description: Deterministic phase-1 coding-runner gates. Each fixture is a small repository written to an empty directory before the runner starts; checks run from that directory after the runner's handoff.

tasks.prompt: Create src/math.js exporting a function sum(a, b) that returns the numeric sum of its two arguments.
src/count.js counts past the end of the array. Fix the loop so count(items) returns the number of elements.
checks: node -e "const { count } = require('./src/count.js'); if (count([1, 2, 3]) !== 3 || count([]) !== 0) process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Add an exported validateEmail(value) function to src/validate.js. It must accept normal email addresses and reject empty strings, strings without @ and strings without a dot after @.
checks: node -e "const { validateEmail } = require('./src/validate.js'); if (!validateEmail('a@example.com') || validateEmail('') || validateEmail('a@b') || validateEmail('nope')) process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Move formatName from src/index.js into a new src/format.js module, export it there, and update index.js to import it. Keep the public behavior unchanged.
checks: node -e "const { formatName } = require('./src/format.js'); if (formatName('Ada', 'Lovelace') !== 'Ada Lovelace') process.exit(1)"
node -e "const { formatName } = require('./src/index.js'); if (formatName('Ada', 'Lovelace') !== 'Ada Lovelace') process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Make cli.js support a --upper flag. Without it, print the first argument unchanged; with it, print the argument uppercased.
src/sequence.js logs an async value before it is ready. Add the missing await so collect() resolves to ['a', 'b'] in order.
Replace the magic number 3000 in src/wait.js with an exported constant TIMEOUT_MS and use it in the function.
checks: node -e "const m = require('./src/wait.js'); if (m.TIMEOUT_MS !== 3000 || typeof m.deadline !== 'function') process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: src/config.js throws on malformed JSON. Change parseConfig(text) to return null for invalid JSON and the parsed object otherwise.
checks: node -e "const { parseConfig } = require('./src/config.js'); if (parseConfig('{oops') !== null || parseConfig(JSON.stringify({ a: 1 })).a !== 1) process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Add test/math.test.js using node:test to cover src/math.js for positive, zero and negative inputs. Do not change src/math.js.
Implement exported sortByAge(people) in src/sort.js. It must return a new array sorted by ascending age and must not mutate the input.
checks: node -e "const { sortByAge } = require('./src/sort.js'); const people = [{age: 3}, {age: 1}, {age: 2}]; const out = sortByAge(people); if (out.map((p) => p.age).join(',') !== '1,2,3' || people[0].age !== 3) process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Implement exported isNonEmptyString(value) in src/guard.js. It returns true only for strings with at least one non-whitespace character.
checks: node -e "const { isNonEmptyString } = require('./src/guard.js'); if (!isNonEmptyString('ok') || isNonEmptyString('') || isNonEmptyString('   ') || isNonEmptyString(7)) process.exit(1)"

tasks.prompt: Add a Usage section to README.md showing how to run `node cli.js hello`. Keep the existing title.
